subject.title: fix(net-policy): preserve repeated secret query params

question: Should this PR preserve git managed-repo cache identity for duplicate-secret git specs before merge, or may maintainers accept a one-time re-clone/update-mode drift for that rare shape?
rationale: The compatibility impact is tied to persisted git install identity, and automation should not decide whether that upgrade drift is acceptable for existing users.

options.title: Require cache-key compatibility
options.body: Keep the display redaction fix but decouple or preserve the git install cache key and add focused regression coverage before merge.

options.title: Accept rare update drift
options.body: Land the redaction behavior knowing duplicate-secret git specs may re-clone or be treated as fresh installs after upgrade.

recommendation.title: Require cache-key compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the display redaction fix but decouple or preserve the git install cache key and add focused regression coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is centered on the git-install managed repo identity path as well as the shared net-policy helper.
